content_fields.title: Protect sensitive data at rest with encryption
content_fields.description: Encrypt sensitive data at rest across the systems that hold it.
content_fields.guidance: Data classified as sensitive should be encrypted wherever it resides — database files, backups, log archives and object storage — with keys managed centrally and rotated.
content_fields.found: The database volume, any log output and any backup copy are all unencrypted.
content_fields.missing: Storage encryption across each of those layers plus a key management service.
content_fields.conclusion: Encryption at rest spans storage platforms and key management, which are infrastructure concerns.
content_fields.action: The platform team should apply encryption at rest to every store holding this service's data.
